title: Preparing for Practice Period
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett invites the group to reflect on how to integrate mindfulness into daily life by exploring what kind of committed practice each individual can commit to, drawing from their experience teaching meditation to veterans who found it profoundly healing. They share stories about Bodhidharma's student Huike, highlighting the importance of steady and patient presence, humility, and radical acceptance in cultivating a strong practice. Nomon encourages discussion and exploration during practice period on how to create space for mindfulness in daily life, considering new approaches and attitudes that can benefit both individuals and their communities.
